summary: A Sydney CBD law firm that offers immigration, property, commercial and family law appears to lose enquiries to a free builder address and raw page text.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address makes a law firm look temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read 1993, with no current year.
findings.cost: An old year makes a visitor doubt the firm is active.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: No reviews or client results appear on the homepage text.
findings.cost: Clients choosing a firm for a visa or property matter look for proof first.
findings.fix: Named client reviews and short case examples.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, and a menu item reads RESPONSIBILITY with no explanation.
findings.cost: Migration clients often message first and unclear menu items lose them.
